Meet The Owner

How Surrey & Sussex Electrical Started

Scott Skinner started college in 2016 and set up his own business when he was 24. In his words, he's never looked back.

Today the team is 3. We work for homeowners, landlords, property managers, builders and businesses across Surrey and Sussex, on everything from domestic installations and full house rewires to commercial maintenance, inspections, new builds and specialist installations.

"Our approach is simple: quality work, honest advice and a reliable service you can trust."

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    NAPIT Certified

    Our NAPIT certificates (registration 76645) cover electrical installations in homes and in other buildings, periodic inspection and testing of both, and self-certifying electrical installations in homes under the Building Regulations. EICRs and testing.

  2. 02

    Insured

    Our insurance covers public liability up to £2,000,000, professional indemnity up to £1,000,000 and employers liability up to £10,000,000.

  3. 03

    A 12 Month Guarantee

    Our work comes with a 12 month guarantee. Ask us about it.

  4. 04

    Qualified for the Job

    Between us we hold Level 2, Level 3 and NVQ qualifications, plus test and inspection and EV charger qualifications. EV chargers.

  5. 05

    Homes and Businesses, In and Out of Hours

    A domestic EICR is done in working hours and usually takes 1 to 4 hours. A commercial one usually happens out of hours, because the power has to go off. Commercial and industrial work.

What We Stand For
